corrected_fields.bug_semantics: The JAX-RS configuration endpoints (/api/configuration/{name} and /api/configuration/detailed/{name}) passed the path parameter into Configs.validate(), whose blacklist rejected literal slash, backslash, '..', blank input, and a trailing dot but allowed percent signs and other non-allowlisted characters. The validated name was then appended with '.cfg' and passed to ConfigUtil.getConfigStream(), which constructs and opens a filesystem path under the configured directory. At introduction the routes sat behind Jetty DigestAuthenticator on /* (only /api/health was unauthenticated). GHSA-hxf2-gm22-7vcm and published CVE-2026-35583 classify this as CWE-22 because encoded, double-encoded, or normalization variants could bypass the blacklist and disclose configuration data outside the intended directory.
